threats.point: Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.

Having said that, we are seeing positive growth based on the services and products that we are rolling out, and expect this to be a strong financial year." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: The international business was relatively flat in YoY comparison, and dollar appreciation had a reciprocal impact on revenues.
